records.description: SeedText — turn any niche keyword into a publish-ready Markdown draft, streamed live.

records.name: Auto Subtitle Generator
records.tagline: Auto Generate Subtitles For Your Videos In Seconds
records.description: Auto Subtitle Generator.io creates accurate subtitles fast, with the micro-level customization most tools miss. Fine-tune motion effects, text styles, neon, underlines, pill backgrounds, borders, colors, and more. Generate, edit, style, and export captions from one simple tool, built for creators who want speed without giving up creative control.

records.name: Claude vs Perplexity for Freelancers
records.tagline: A practical 2026 comparison for freelance work
records.description: A practical comparison of Claude AI and Perplexity AI for freelancers in 2026, covering research, writing, content creation, productivity, workflows, and common freelance use cases. The guide focuses on how each AI tool can fit into real freelance workflows rather than comparing features alone.

records.name: EQMO.
records.tagline: Human approval for what your AI agent writes
records.description: EQMO. is human-in-the-loop document approval for AI agents. Your agent (Claude Code, opencode, anything with MCP or REST) submits markdown documents and waits. Humans get an email, highlight text, comment, approve or request changes — with versioning, approval chains, and an audit trail.

records.name: BentoUtils
records.tagline: 200+ niche tools that run in your browser
records.description: 200+ browser-based calculators, each on its own page and built to answer one question fast. Enter your numbers, get the result. No installs.

records.name: Kairos
records.tagline: A free planner that turns your tasks into a schedule
records.description: Kairos schedules tasks around your available hours, priorities and deadlines. Keep work in order with dependencies, plan recurring routines and make room for breaks. Choose Automatic scheduling or decide when to reschedule in Manual mode. The core planner is free, including Stopwatch and Pomodoro timers. Optional read-only Google Calendar access is US$5.99/month or US$49.99/year, plus applicable taxes. No paid-plan free trial.

records.name: Doyouok
records.tagline: Simple heartbeat & cron job monitoring for workflows.
records.description: Doyouok monitors cron jobs, scheduled tasks, background scripts, and workflows (n8n, Zapier, Make). Get instant alerts the moment a job stops checking in. Zero setup overhead, no agent or SDK required. Free plan includes 5 Checks with no credit card required.

records.name: Dola AI Watermark Remover
records.tagline: dola ai video watermark remover
records.description: Remove the Dola AI watermark from images and videos free. Clean PNG, JPG, WebP, MP4, WebM, and MOV files directly in your browser with zero uploads and lossless results.

records.name: Awnsy
records.tagline: Offline AI translator for Mac. Press ⌘C twice, done.
records.description: Awnsy is a small menu bar translator for macOS. Select text in any app, press ⌘C twice, and the translation appears right over the window. For text you can't select, like images, scanned PDFs or video, drag a box around it and Awnsy reads and translates it. The translation model lives inside the app and runs on your Mac. No account, no API key, works offline, and what you translate stays on your machine. If you prefer cloud quality, add your own OpenAI or Anthropic key.

records.name: AI Agents
records.tagline: AI Agents
records.description: Visit the website for detailed information.

records.name: DrawingBlanks
records.tagline: Puzzle Word Game
records.description: Super fun word game that is great for solo daily play, but also offers a great amount of social features to compete with friends and create your own custom puzzles to share and challenge others

records.name: Zipprr Bolt Clone
records.tagline: Launch a white-label ride-hailing app in 7 days
records.description: Zipprr's Bolt Clone is a white-label ride-hailing platform with rider app, driver app, and admin panel — full source code included. Launch in 7 days instead of 12-18 months, with AI-powered dispatch, ML-based surge pricing, and driver-friendly commissions (15-20% vs industry's 25-30%). Built for founders, fleet operators, and agencies who want to own their platform outright, not rent a SaaS subscription.

records.name: KeyoAPI
records.tagline: One API for Multiple AI Models
records.description: KeyoAPI is a prepaid AI API relay: one OpenAI-compatible base URL and one wallet for GPT-class chat, Claude, DeepSeek, Whisper, OCR, vision, TTS, and avatar models. Swap two lines in your existing OpenAI SDK—no new client. Permanent free *-free model IDs for prototyping, then flip to metered twins. Try/buy from Model Square; live rates on the site.

records.name: ND Wire Rope Hoists To Albania
records.tagline: ND Wire Rope Hoists | Electric Wire Rope Hoist
records.description: The 10 sets of ND type wire rope hoists were shipped to Albania on July 7, 2026. For more details, please click here!

records.name: Mouse Keyring
records.tagline: Hang your favorite things from your Mac cursor
records.description: Give your Mac cursor a keyring. Choose an animal or upload any image, then customize its chain and swing. Hang it from window or button corners, let it rest there, and reconnect when you return. Add up to 3 keyrings to make your everyday cursor a little more yours.

records.name: AI Grow Bot
records.tagline: AI-powered WhatsApp automation for business growth
records.description: AIGrowBot is a powerful WhatsApp Marketing platform that enables you to send Bulk Messages, automate campaigns, and connect with customers using the official WhatsApp Business API for maximum engagement and growth.

records.name: Postorie
records.tagline: Publish Once Rank Everywhere
records.description: Postorie is the premier global publishing platform and business hub. Write insightful articles, showcase company catalogs, list premium properties and…

records.name: EAutoKompass
records.tagline: Practical EV range, cost and charging tools for Germany
records.description: EAutoKompass helps German EV buyers and drivers turn headline specs into practical decisions. Free calculators estimate realistic range using weather, speed, load and charging windows; compare leasing and charging costs; check funding; and guide wallbox choices. Assumptions are published, no account is required, and calculator inputs stay in the browser. The goal is clear, transparent planning rather than optimistic brochure numbers.

records.name: Soar90™
records.tagline: Personal 30-60-90 day onboarding plan for any new job
records.description: New job? The first 90 days are too important to leave to chance. Soar90™ is the only personal, self-guided onboarding platform built for new hires. Choose from multiple role-specific tracks, customize your plan, complete daily tasks, log wins, and generate review-ready performance reports in one click or create your own. Use it standalone or alongside any company onboarding. One-time purchase. You got the job, now crush your first 90 days! Also perfect as gift from recruiter or employer.

records.name: ResilAI
records.tagline: Deterministic incident readiness & ops safety for SMBs
records.description: ResilAI answers one question every morning: "Can this organization safely operate today?" We collect telemetry from security tools, IAM, and backups to calculate a deterministic Governance Health Index (GHI) mapped to NIST CSF 2.0. LLMs are strictly forbidden from calculating scores; Gemini only translates findings into plain-English business risks and single high-ROI fixes.

records.name: Gaming Audio: Earbuds vs Headphones.
records.tagline: Gaming Earbuds vs Headphones: Audio and Comfort Compared.
records.description: Wireless over-ear headphones with deep bass, clear sound, and comfortable design for everyday listening.

records.name: 9Mail.xyz
records.tagline: Temporary email with readable names and no sign-up
records.description: Create a free temporary email address for one-time signups, verification codes, and testing. No account required; inboxes expire automatically.

records.name: DIBA : Photo Editor & Tools
records.tagline: Powerful photo editing tools to make your photos pop
records.description: Transform, Edit & Convert Your Photos Effortlessly with DIBA! **About the App:** DIBA is your ultimate all-in-one photo editing and utility toolbox built for fast, high-quality, and easy image management. Whether you want to polish your visual content or quickly process files for daily work, DIBA gets it done in seconds! :** Bring your photos to life with stunning filters, mood adjustments, and aesthetic presets. Simplify your photo editing and conversion tasks with DIBA today!

records.name: MyBusinessCard.digital
records.tagline: 100% FREE digital business cards. No paywalls no watermarks.
records.description: A 100% free, independent digital business card platform with zero ads and no branding. Built from scratch with Pure PHP and Vanilla JS under 0.8MB for instant loading. Features: • Dynamic PWA: Save to home screen in 1 click • 12 editable templates with QR Code & vCard • Rich Open Graph preview for WhatsApp sharing • Translated into 15 languages • Zero-friction Guest Mode: Complete automatic database wipe every 24 hours for maximum privacy.

records.name: DeskPet: Desktop Companion
records.tagline: Animated pets by your side
records.description: DeskPet is a lightweight animated desktop pet app with a growing Pet Store. Choose from cats, dogs, parrots, and other companions, download the pets you love, and switch between them at any time. Every pet has its own personality and exclusive animations. It may walk across windows, rest, sleep, play, climb, look around, or react when the pointer comes near. These natural responses make your pet feel present without getting in the way.

records.name: Apollo
records.tagline: Every WordPress site. One calm desktop app.
records.description: Apollo is a fast, native desktop app for managing every WordPress site you own or look after — create content, keep sites healthy and secure, grow traffic, and look after all your sites from one window. Your sites, your machine, your data.

records.name: Habiit
records.tagline: Build better habits together.
records.description: Habiit is a habit and personal growth app designed to help you stay consistent and turn goals into daily actions. Track habits, build streaks, break goals into milestones, visualize your future, and stay accountable with friends through Shared Habits. Habiit brings habits, goals, vision, and progress together in one simple experience.

records.name: Maxxovo
records.tagline: Turn Your Time Into Opportunity
records.description: 🚀 Meet Maxxovo — Turn Your Skills Into Earnings Maxxovo is a platform where you can complete tasks, submit projects, create content, and earn from your skills. Discover opportunities, contribute your expertise, and build ongoing earning potential—all in one place. ✨ Complete tasks 💡 Submit projects 📝 Create content 💰 Earn rewards 🔄 Build recurring income opportunities Complete. Create. Earn. Repeat.

records.name: Poodle Panic
records.tagline: Two poodles, one thumb, one decision you keep getting wrong
records.description: Catch frisbees, fill the meter, set off the zoomies. The burst makes you faster and harder to control, and the multiplier climbs while you hold it. Bank and it's yours. Crash and it never was. Milky and Mongae are real dogs and they aren't skins: hole widths are computed from whichever one you picked, so the same gap is a different problem. Every obstacle has been proven clearable by a solver. No ads, no timers, no energy, no continues, no account, and no network requests at all.

records.name: TIMEPADS
records.tagline: Period hygiene and care
records.description: Shop premium rash-free, skin-friendly sanitary pads at TIME. Long-lasting high absorbency for all-day comfort and protection. Order online today!

records.name: LiveProof
records.tagline: Prove you're a real human — in about 8 seconds
records.description: LiveProof is a shareable presence stamp. Record a short selfie video, pay once, get a link that shows you were there as a real person at that moment. Built for async deals, remote check-ins, and "are you real?" moments — not government ID, not KYC.

records.name: Your Social Calendar & Community Center.
records.tagline: connects events, people, communication, schedules, community
records.description: BookedYou is an interactive social calendar and community platform that helps people and organizations bring people together. Create events, manage schedules, communicate with guests, share files and photos, use QR codes and digital tickets, coordinate activities, and build lasting community connections—all in one place.

records.name: Ryobi ONE+ 18V Tools
records.tagline: ryobi 18v one + orbital jigsaw p5231, ryobi one+ p5231 18v
records.description: Shop the Ryobi ONE+ 18V tools cordless orbital jig saw for versatile cutting, variable speed control and convenient battery-powered performance.

records.name: VedicQ AI Astrology & Kundli Engine
records.tagline: Computational Vedic astrology with Swiss Ephemeris accuracy
records.description: Chat with VedicQ AI Astrologer 24/7 for real-time Kundli analysis and Vedic astrology predictions. Get personalized birth chart analysis with artificial intelligence.

records.name: SchemaRank
records.tagline: Make your Shopify store visible to AI shopping agents
records.description: AI shopping assistants answer "what should I buy?" from Product JSON-LD — not marketing copy. Most Shopify catalogs are missing GTIN, brand, availability and return schema, so they're invisible to ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. SchemaRank scores your store 0–100 against 9 weighted rules, shows what's missing, and injects complete Product JSON-LD in one click — no theme edits, fully reversible. It never fabricates review ratings. Free scanner, no install: schemarank.app/scan

records.name: KesarGlow
records.tagline: Licensed Indian B2B exporter & private label
records.description: Licensed Indian B2B exporter & private label contract manufacturer of Grade-A Kashmiri Kumkumadi & Bakuchiol serums from Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

records.name: DocBrief
records.tagline: Short YouTube docs without an editor or GPU studio
records.description: Faceless and solo creators who need a short YouTube documentary without an editor or GPU film studio. Paste a topic or rough script. Get a polished voiceover script, TTS, B-roll stills, burned-in captions, and a downloadable MP4. Starter $12 / Creator $36. Built by WedgeWerks — a product factory, not a platform.

records.name: ZeroFee.gg
records.tagline: A 0% seller-fee P2P marketplace for gamers
records.description: ZeroFee.gg is a global P2P gaming marketplace where gamers can buy and sell directly with 0% seller fees. Discover gaming listings, connect with buyers and sellers through chat, explore top sellers, and use Trust Check tools to check gaming profiles. Built for gamers who want more freedom and control over their trades. We're building ZeroFee for gamers, and we'd love your feedback!

records.name: Tow Deputy
records.tagline: AI voice receptionist for 24/7 built specifically for towing
records.description: Tow Deputy is the AI dispatcher and receptionist for towing and roadside assistance companies. It answers every call 24/7, quotes your exact prices — including zone-based hook-up fees — collects vehicle & location details, takes deposits, and dispatches your closest driver.

records.name: The Attic Suite
records.tagline: Pull your scattered digital life into one private place
records.description: The Attic is five local desktop apps — EmailAttic, PictureAttic, DocAttic, ChatAttic, ContactAttic — that pull your scattered data (old backups, dead phones, cloud exports) into one de-duplicated archive on your own computer. Nothing is uploaded, no account, no subscription: buy one app, a Trio, or the whole Suite. Born from consolidating one family's 736,000 emails and 472,982 photos.

records.name: EventAssets
records.tagline: A web-based event management tool and private media gallery.
records.description: EventAssets is an all-in-one event hub and shared media gallery designed to simplify event planning and collective photo sharing. It gives hosts a centralized page to communicate key details while allowing guests to contribute their own photos and videos directly from any mobile web browser.

records.name: AppGazers
records.tagline: Find winning app niches in seconds and build what sells now.
records.description: Building apps blindly is dead. AppGazers gives you an unfair advantage by revealing untapped niches and apps quietly making massive MRR. Unlike traditional tools, you can use our intuitive UI or ask your favorite AI agents (ChatGPT/Claude) in plain language to find your next winning app idea. We analyze millions of App Store and Play Store data points so you can track competitors, spot trends early, and build with conviction. Stop guessing. Start building what sells.

records.name: Launch Kit
records.tagline: Your first $1K digital product, planned and launched
records.description: Everything you need to plan, build, and launch your first $1,000 digital product — from idea to sales page. $149, instant download.

records.name: Badminton Guy
records.tagline: Match rackets & tension to your exact biomechanics
records.description: Stop guessing your badminton gear. Badminton Guy uses equipment telemetry and player biomechanics to match the ideal frame stiffness, balance, safe string tension, and doubles synergy in 60 seconds.

records.name: Drake AI
records.tagline: A simple AI assistant for everyday conversations
records.description: Drake AI is a simple AI assistant built for everyday conversations. Ask questions, explore ideas, brainstorm, learn, and get AI-powered answers through a clean web experience. With Google sign-in and a fast chat interface, Drake AI makes starting a conversation with AI simple and accessible.

records.name: Social Recommendator - new UI
records.tagline: Better Recommendations
records.description: AI Social Recommendator - Generate professional recommendations for social and business network endorsements using AI.

records.name: Jeansh
records.tagline: The SSH client for vibe coding away from your desk
records.description: An Android SSH client for working away from your desk. Chat with Claude Code on your machine, paste it screenshots, run native tmux panes, browse and edit files, query PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis, and get a push when a long job is done. Free, no account.
